description: Research screen r102 arm (H200, end to end: the promotion screen for a track D record with the speed stack): D 007 with every same-maths speed change so far. Pretraining: Muon lr 4e-3 on the fused path (--fused-loss --micro-batch 128) for 46 min instead of 56 (r92: about the tokens the old path gave in 56). RL: the same-process sampler (rollout_backend 'native'; constrain_batched off, a vLLM option), reuse_sampler_allowed, share_group_prompt, micro_batch_tokens 65,536, time_budget_s 18,000 instead of 17,400; the same 20,760 s in total. It is r99's B200 arm plus reuse_sampler_allowed (r100: bit-identical, update -14.5 %). r101 (B200, RL only from D 007's checkpoints) put the RL settings at about 1.9x the steps of D 007's in the same 17,400 s. Seeds 0-2; read by final dev against the track D promotion line and against D 007's kept dev by seed.
